verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that opportunities carry a status and an optional monetary amount, and that Close offers general pipeline management and reporting. Nothing documents revenue forecasting, stage probabilities, or close-date-based projections. Exporting pipeline data to BI tools would be a user-side workaround, not the product's own forecasting capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forecast revenue from pipeline value, stage probabilities, and close dates
